newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB director Dickins to retire.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB director Dickins to retire.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd chairman Bill Irvine said on Thursday that David Dickins will retire from the bank's board, effective October 31.

Dickins has been a director of the bank since 1981 and was a director of The Commercial Banking Co of Sydney Ltd for the 14 years immediately prior to its merger with National Australia, Irvine said in a statement.
"We have had the benefit of Mr Dickins' experience and good judgement during a period of major growth for the banking group," Irvine said.
